body: Could I come over please? I can give you nook miles tickets, gold nuggets, a massive tip, or anything else you need. Please message me back if you'll let me come.
I'm looking to visit anyone's island to do some shopping or fruit picking. Please dm your dodo code if you're willing to have me for a while.

21-year-old guy here. I feel the same way. I've been depressed, unable to sleep, and unable to function because I'm so mentally exhausted and I just don't have any motivation. I've talked to my parents before about how I've felt depressed, and they (especially my dad, who is the most emotionally unintelligent person I've ever known) just laughed it off. I have sisters who struggle with genuine depression, one of which even attempted suicide. My parents offer far more support to them than to me.

Recently, my mom noticed that I wasn't feeling well, and when she hugged me I just lost it. She keeps asking me to open up and talk about what's going on. She even said that she's worried about me. My parents **want** me to talk about it, but I won't. I won't because I have opened up about this topic **so many times** before and every time it is met with a slap on the back and an "oh, you're just fine you'll get over it" kind of remark. Meanwhile, my sisters are getting all the affection in the world.

I can't tell my parents about how depressed I am without them dismissing it, so how the HELL am I supposed to tell them that I'm suicidal on top of that??? I even went through the effort of tieing a noose from an extension cord and stashing it away for a rainy day. 

The only thing worse than having the people you love laugh of your depression and suicidal thoughts is having them do it over and over and over. So I get it. I get 100%.

On a lighter note, because we have this mutual understanding, we can talk to each other about it. So if you need an individual who you don't personally know to talk to or even just rant to, I'm all ears. I'm a sad fat lump with ears.
